Alex Martinez: Hey team — I'm submitting my two-week notice today. My last day will be 2026-04-10. Can we coordinate COBRA/benefits, final payroll, and access cutover? cc @Priya Rao @Jordan Lee
Priya Rao: Thanks for the heads-up, Alex. We'll start the offboard checklist. Quick notes: health coverage runs through 2026-04-30, COBRA enrollment window opens on separation and you have 60 days to elect. I'll DM the benefits packet and link to the COBRA form.
Jordan Lee: Appreciate the heads-up, Alex. Please list your top 3 ongoing tasks and any critical runbooks you own. I want to schedule a 1:1 handoff with Nora this week.
Alex Martinez: Top tasks: 1) async batching service (runs on staging + prod), 2) billing-run reconciliation scripts, 3) onboarding docs for new ded infra. Runbooks: "async-batching.md" in /docs, and "billing-recon-playbook" in Confluence. I'll add Nora as editor on Drive now.
Nora Chen: I can take the async batching runbook and the onboarding doc. Alex, add me to the repo and Drive folder and I'll set up a transfer checklist.
Priya Rao: Final paycheck will go out on the next payroll cycle after your last day. For equity, your vesting cutoff is the last day — comp will follow the standard separation policy. I'll book an exit interview for next Tue unless you prefer another time.
Alex Martinez: Tue works. Prefer morning (PST). Also, any chance to keep staging access for 7 days post-last-day to finish handoff? Would make the transfer smoother.
IT Oncall: Staging access post-offboard can be done via a temporary service account. Requires manager approval + IT ticket. Badge and SSO deprovision happen on the last day by default (5pm badge, 6pm SSO). GitHub org removal typically 6:30pm. If you need a 7-day service account, Jordan needs to approve in the ticket.
Jordan Lee: I approve a 7-day service account for Alex to finish the handoff. Alex — please file a ticket to IT with the list of repos and Drive folders you need access to.
Taylor Nguyen: Heads-up: we may need Alex to update the RBAC in k8s for the batching service before access is cut. Alex, can you leave a short checklist for the k8s role bindings?
Alex Martinez: Will do. Quick snippet I'll leave in the runbook:
``` 
# rebind service account
kubectl -n ops get rolebinding batching-access -o yaml > /tmp/batching-rb.yaml
# edit subjects to replace alex@redwood.com with service-account@redwood-svc
kubectl apply -f /tmp/batching-rb.yaml
```
Nora Chen: I'll validate the RBAC changes in staging once Alex hands off.
People Ops Bot: Benefits packet: https://hr.redwood.com/benefits/packet | COBRA form: https://hr.redwood.com/cobra-enroll | Exit interview scheduler: https://cal.redwood.com/priya/exit
Priya Rao: Alex, can you confirm company laptop return logistics? We can provide a pre-paid shipping label or schedule drop-off at HQ. Also note: VPN and laptop SSO tokens will be revoked on the last day, so please push any encrypted backups to Drive or transfer to Nora before then.
Alex Martinez: I'll ship the laptop back using the prepaid label. Will transfer backups to Drive and ensure Nora has copies of encrypted keys.
IT Oncall: Reminder checklist for deprovisioning (for record): badge deactivated at 17:00 local on 2026-04-10; SSO/Okta deauth at 18:00; GSuite mailbox forwarding set to manager for 30 days; GitHub org membership removed at 18:30 unless org owner override requested; Slack will be deactivated and messages preserved per retention policy.
Priya Rao: Noted on mailbox forwarding — Jordan, please confirm who should receive Alex's mail after separation. Also we'll send COBRA election instructions to Alex's personal email as well.
Jordan Lee: Forward to me (jordan@redwood.com). I'll triage for 30 days then escalate to ops if needed.
Alex Martinez: Thanks everyone — I'll file the IT ticket now and accept the exit interview invite. Appreciate the smooth process.
Nora Chen: Welcome to ping me if anything else needs transfer.
People Ops Bot: Offboarding checklist created: https://hr.redwood.com/offboards/1901234567 | Ticket # will be linked once created.
